item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Expect sunny skies today with high temperatures ranging from fifty-six to sixty-nine degrees and only a slight chance of rain showers tonight, mainly in the Champlain Valley and Essex County New York, where a few brief showers are possible. Tonight turns mostly cloudy with lows between thirty-five and forty-nine degrees, but most areas stay dry. Friday brings partly to mostly sunny conditions and highs in the mid-fifties to upper fifties, with minimal precipitation expected.
